title: Stationary solutions to the spherically symmetric compressible fluid with capillarity effect
summary: We consider the spherically symmetric Navier--Stokes--Korteweg (NSK) system on the exterior domain $Ω=\{x\in\mathbb{R}^n~|~|x|>1\}$ with $n\ge2$ when the boundary and far-field data are given. We show that, if the boundary data are sufficiently small, then there exists a unique smooth stationary solution to the spherically symmetric NSK system with impermeable wall, inflow, and outflow boundary conditions.
